label: reference-occurrence-verified
invocation: async (page) => {const id=await page.evaluate(()=>decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1))),target=page.locator(`[id="${id}"]`);if(!id||await target.count()!==1)throw new Error("Missing reference occurrence");await target.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();return {landedUrl:page.url(),occurrenceFound:true,occurrenceText:await target.textContent(),noOverflow:await page.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.scrollWidth<=innerWidth+1)};}
